scope: CPU-only preregistration for a same-image dual-processor-pixel-budget counterfactual on frozen ADE20K samples. No model has been run and no GPU was used to create this file.

motivation.rationale_zh: 原始 full2638 中 G>512 门控与 source_dataset 高度混同（Cramer's V≈0.88，Hypersim/nuScenes 完全落在门内）；ADE20K 是唯一同时跨越 G<=512 与 G>512 的数据源，其同源 Prompt−integer 效应差的 95% CI 未整体 >0（下界 <0），因此原 G 对比无法把分辨率与数据源身份分开。本预注册改为固定同一张图、只改变 processor pixel budget，从图像内部识别分辨率效应。

stratification.allocation: proportional largest-remainder over the eight strata with a per-stratum floor of min(4, n_available)

high.label: high
high.note: min_pixels = 513 * 1024 forces G >= 513; max_pixels stays at the model default

gate_separation.replacement_rule: for each dropped sample take the next unused reserve candidate from the same stratum in ascending selection_rank whose own two budgets separate; if the stratum reserve is exhausted the sample is unresolved and the dry run fails closed; the dry run must resolve all 100 samples before any model run
gate_separation.analytic_prediction_note: the analytic mode mirrors the released Qwen smart_resize formula and is only a non-authoritative self-check; it must not be treated as the required processor dry run

runner.command_template: python evaluation/run_hf_same_image_resolution_counterfactual.py --model /home/zhaoxiangyu/RoboBrain2.5/RoboBrain2.5-4B --model-label RoboBrain2.5-4B-BF16 --manifest datasets/2026-10-04-same-image-resolution-counterfactual-ade20k100-separated.jsonl --arm <ARM> --pixel-budget low --min-pixels 65536 --max-pixels 524288 --output artifacts/token_selector/2026-10-04-same-image-resolution-counterfactual/<ARM>_low.jsonl ; then repeat with --pixel-budget high --min-pixels 525312 --max-pixels 16777216 --output .../<ARM>_high.jsonl

comparison.per_image_effect_high: (Prompt_correct - Integer_correct) at the high pixel budget
comparison.per_image_effect_low: (Prompt_correct - Integer_correct) at the low pixel budget
comparison.primary_metric: unweighted per-sample paired difference (the official cv_bench_accuracy is undefined inside the single ADE20K source)
secondary_metrics: wrong_to_right / right_to_wrong / net correction counts per budget

decision_rule.RESOLUTION_DEPENDENT_PROMPT_GAIN_CONFIRM: 95% stratified paired bootstrap CI of the primary estimand has lower bound > 0
decision_rule.RESOLUTION_DEPENDENT_PROMPT_GAIN_NOT_CON: otherwise (including a CI containing 0 or entirely < 0)

forbidden: changing the formal full2638 conclusion or its reports
selecting thresholds or samples after seeing counterfactual outputs
using any revealed blind or validation manifest
quoting pointing/grounding/ndcg/retained-mass as the primary metric
claiming GPU/FPGA latency, speedup or accuracy from this preregistration
